reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's V4 pipeline (V3 linear-ST with per-platform fit Cf/Cr and per-segment straight-line bias correction, plus LOSO Ridge residual learner on [v, |a_y|, |delta|, sign(d delta/dt)]) on all 545 canonical Ford segments, fitting and LOSO-ing per platform.
notes: V3 Cf/Cr fit per platform: {'FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1': {'Cf': 150000.0, 'Cr': 150000.0, 'pegged': False}, 'FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1': {'Cf': 150000.0, 'Cr': 150000.0, 'pegged': False}}. V4 = V3(linear-ST steady-state with per-segment straight-bias correction) plus a LOSO Ridge(alpha=1) residual learner on [v, |a_y|, |delta|, sign(d delta/dt)]. Reconstructed via re-ran-script: ran the agent's exact pipeline (triage.fit_c_alpha + triage.linear_st_yaw_rate + LOSO Ridge) per platform across all 545 canonical Ford segments. Agent's published V4 used only the first 60 Mach-E segments; canonical eval extends the same recipe to all 315 Mach-E + 230 Lightning segments, with Cf/Cr fit and LOSO performed within each platform (parameters differ across platforms).
